data.name: Southern Charm Front Yard
data.one_line: A refined, symmetrical front yard with evergreen hedges, flowering shrubs, and Southern elegance.
data.prompt_text:
Create a front yard landscape inspired by the Southern Charm Front Yard style.

Core Theme: Traditional Southern curb appeal with structure and symmetry.
Design Intent: Elegant layout with ornamental trees, evergreens, and seasonal color.
Plant Palette: Crape Myrtle or Magnolia ‘Little Gem’, Azaleas or Camellias, Boxwood, Pansies or Petunias.
Color Profile: Greens, whites, pinks, reds with annual pops.
Textures & Layers: Tree → shrub → low hedge layering.
Hardscape: Flagstone paths, planters, formal layout.
Regional Adaptations: Sunny – crape myrtle/azalea; Shade – magnolia/camellia.
Prompt: Emphasize symmetry, structured layering, and polished materials for a timeless front yard.

Most importantly, please keep the house and structure the exact same. only the above changes to the front yard and landscape areas.

data.name: Low Maintenance Southern Garden
data.one_line: A tidy, low-fuss Southern landscape using evergreens, seasonal color, and clean borders.
data.prompt_text:
Create a front yard or backyard landscape inspired by the Low Maintenance Southern Garden style.

Core Theme: Designed for homeowners who value curb appeal with minimal effort.
Design Intent: Tidy, structured with evergreen backbone and seasonal color. Minimal pruning, drought tolerance, and weed suppression.
Plant Palette: Dwarf Yaupon Holly, Knock Out® Roses, Autumn Sage, Liriope, Muhly Grass, Pine straw or mulch.
Color Profile: Spring/summer – fuchsia, pink, purple; Fall/winter – evergreen + bronze grasses.
Textures & Layers: Low-to-medium height; structured layering (liriope → flowering accents → evergreens).
Hardscape: Clean-edged beds, mulch or pine straw, optional stepping stones or planters.
Regional Adaptations: Sun – salvia/muhly; Shade – hydrangea/abelia; Slope – liriope for cover.
Prompt: Emphasize neat borders, evergreen structure, and seasonal color with clean lines and minimal maintenance.

Most importantly, please keep the house and structure the exact same. only the above changes to the front yard and landscape areas.

data.name: Drought Tolerant Delta Blend
data.one_line: A sculptural, low-water garden with bold forms, gravel paths, and Southern resilience.
data.prompt_text:
Create a front or back yard landscape inspired by the Drought Tolerant Delta Blend style.

Core Theme: Resilient and bold design for hot, dry Southern climates.
Design Intent: Sculptural layout with dry-climate ornamentals, gravel, and bold forms.
Plant Palette: Yucca or Agave, Purple Fountain Grass, Blanket Flower, Russian Sage, Sedum.
Color Profile: Silvers, burgundies, oranges, dusty greens.
Textures & Layers: Bold vertical and mounded forms; open spacing.
Hardscape: Gravel/decomposed granite, stone accents, corten edging.
Regional Adaptations: Full sun – maximize sage/agave; Clay – raise beds or use sedum.
Prompt: Focus on artistic, sculptural form with heat-tolerant, drought-friendly plants in rhythmic groupings.

data.name: Woodland Native Retreat
data.one_line: A serene, naturalized shade garden with native trees, ferns, and understory layers.
data.prompt_text:
Generate a landscape design inspired by the Woodland Native Retreat style.

Core Theme: A calm, layered garden inspired by Mississippi’s woodlands.
Design Intent: Forest floor feel with native layers and textural interest.
Plant Palette: Oakleaf Hydrangea, Southern Wood Fern, Coral Bells, Dogwood or Redbud, River Birch.
Color Profile: Greens, whites, pale purples, fall bronzes.
Textures & Layers: Canopy → shrub → fern/coral bells.
Hardscape: Mulch paths, stone, bird baths.
Regional Adaptations: Shade – ferns/coral bells; Dappled – redbud/hydrangea; Large – river birch.
Prompt: Mimic a forest understory with organic layers, native shade-tolerant plants, and calming hardscape.
